decisions.reason: Copper-coated glass substrates build directly on the firm's long glass processing, polishing and patterning know-how, so it can interpret market feedback and refine the ACT line through its own R&D, and glass packaging substrates are a strategic growth area.

Laser-based through-glass via structuring extends the firm's core glass competence into higher-value semiconductor packaging, matches its stated investment in newer processing technologies, and was only launched in 2024, so its own R&D and research cooperation give it time and capacity to develop the product further.
